note: Roll chain, second pair, step 2 NO: simple movement with nothing at stake, and the corner table is established as free. No dice, no oracle.

storySnapshot.premise: A mountain toll-town in winter. Ilse Varrow, a courier, carries a sealed tin to the toll-house at the far end of the Pim causeway.

parts.content: The common room of the Kettle & Rook is half empty. The corner table by the shuttered window is free, and the benches around it are dry.

lore.title: Character: Ilse Varrow
lore.content: Ilse Varrow, courier. Quick, stubborn, owes the Hobnail Guild a debt. Carries a sealed tin she has not opened.

playerLine: I walk across the common room and sit at the corner table.
